hotel.name: Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong

verified_facts.text: All guestrooms have Victoria Harbour views through expansive windows
verified_facts.excerpt: All guestrooms offer sweeping Victoria Harbour views through expansive windows.

verified_facts.text: Birdsong, the lobby lounge and bar, is a double-height space with mid-century-style terrazzo floors, starburst chandeliers and pink velvet chairs
verified_facts.excerpt: Birdsong lobby lounge and bar, an airy double-height space where mid-century-style terrazzo floors and starburst chandeliers blend with curvaceous pink velvet chairs and dusky blue drapes

verified_facts.text: A daily social hour offers complimentary wine, fruit punch and canapes
verified_facts.excerpt: In Hong Kong, that includes a choice of complimentary Chardonnay, Shiraz, fruit punch, and sweet and savory canapés.

verified_facts.text: JIJA is an independent Chinese bistro inspired by Yunnan-Guizhou flavors
verified_facts.excerpt: An independent Chinese bistro inspired by Yunnan

verified_facts.text: JIJA is helmed by chef Vicky Lau, founder of Tate Dining Room
verified_facts.excerpt: Jija, helmed by two-Michelin star chef Vicky Lau, local hero and founder of Tate Dining Room

verified_facts.text: Swim Club is a poolside cocktail bar on the 50th floor
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in exotic, playful cocktails crafted with innovative techniques and infused with local flavors on our 50th-floor poolside oasis.

verified_facts.text: Birdsong serves Elephant Grounds coffee and artisanal sandwiches
verified_facts.excerpt: Sip exclusive Elephant Grounds coffee and savor house-fermented delights and artisanal sandwiches

verified_facts.text: Hillside serves a breakfast buffet by day and modern dai pai dong dining at night
verified_facts.excerpt: all star breakfast buffet by day, savor modern dai pai dong dining with bold twists on Chinese classics by night

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop infinity pool
The rooftop pool area has sunbeds and private cabanas
verified_facts.excerpt: Surrounded by plush sunbeds and private cabanas, this elevated oasis offers a serene escape.
Energize at our 200 sqm HYROX-affiliated fitness center.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome, with rooms on a pet floor that allow one cat or dog
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms on the pet floor allow one cat or dog under 15kg

verified_facts.text: Children receive special amenities including slippers, shampoo, shower gel and toothbrushes
verified_facts.excerpt: little ones are given special amenities, including slippers, shampoo, shower gel, and toothbrushes

verified_facts.text: The building has a flying V shape
The Kimpton Harbour Suites have a sunken jacuzzi next to the bedroom window
verified_facts.excerpt: Kimpton Harbour Suites, where I stayed, which has a sunken jacuzzi positioned next to the bedroom window

verified_facts.text: Guests can rent hiking gear and use hiking guides at no charge
verified_facts.excerpt: free-to-rent gear and hiking guides packed with trails suitable for every level

verified_facts.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel
verified_facts.excerpt: No, there is not a complimentary local area shuttle available at Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong.

verified_facts.text: MTR East Tsim Sha Tsui Station is listed among public transportation options
verified_facts.excerpt: MTR East Tsim Sha Tsui Station

verified_facts.text: The hotel is described as better suited to grown-ups, though families are welcome
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is better suited to grown-ups
